schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly instalments directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

clauses.text: The beneficiary must be a member of a landholding farmer family that owns cultivable land.
The applicant must hold cultivable land in their own name; landless agricultural labourers are not covered.
Institutional landholders, income-tax payers and serving or retired government employees drawing a pension above Rs. 10,000 per month stand excluded.
Aadhaar seeding of the beneficiary's bank account and completion of e-KYC is mandatory for release of instalments.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Crop insurance against yield loss from natural calamity, pest and disease, at a farmer premium of 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.

clauses.text: All farmers growing notified crops in a notified area, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, are eligible to enrol.
The farmer must have an insurable interest in the notified crop, evidenced by land records or a valid tenancy agreement.
Enrolment is voluntary for all farmers following the 2020 revision of the scheme.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Short-term crop loan at a concessional interest rate, with interest subvention and prompt-repayment incentive reducing the effective rate to about 4% per annum.

clauses.text: All farmers who are individual or joint cultivators and owner-cultivators are eligible.
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and members of joint liability groups are also covered.
The applicant must have attained 18 years of age and must not exceed 75 years at the time of application.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after the age of 60, against a matched monthly contribution during the enrolment period.

clauses.text: The scheme is open to small and marginal farmers cultivating up to 2 hectares of land.
The applicant must be a farmer by occupation.
The entry age of the applicant must be between 18 and 40 years.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.benefits: Skill training with a stipend, a toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000, and collateral-free enterprise loans of up to Rs. 3 lakh at a concessional 5% interest rate.

clauses.text: The applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with their hands and tools in one of the eighteen notified family-based trades.
The applicant must have completed 18 years of age on the date of registration.
Persons in government service and their family members are not eligible for benefits under this scheme.

documents: Caste or trade certificate where applicable

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition and non-refundable fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance for students pursuing post-matriculation courses.

clauses.text: The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste as notified by the Government of India.
The annual income of the parents or guardians from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
The applicant must be studying at a post-matriculation stage, that is Class 11 or above, in a recognised institution.

schemes.name: Pre Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students (Class 9 and 10)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
schemes.benefits: Monthly scholarship and an annual book grant for Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

clauses.text: The student must belong to a Scheduled Tribe.
The student must be enrolled in Class 9 or Class 10 in a government or recognised school.
The annual income of the parents or guardians must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 from all sources.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest drop-out at Class 8 and support study through Class 12.

clauses.text: The student must be studying in Class 9 to Class 12 in a government, local body or government-aided school.
The annual income of parents from all sources must not exceed Rs. 3,50,000.
The student must have secured at least 55% marks in the Class 7 examination, with relaxation for reserved categories.

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 50,000 per annum towards tuition fees and incidentals for girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree and diploma programmes.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a girl student admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma programme.
The applicant must be pursuing an undergraduate technical course.
The family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 per annum.

schemes.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 50,000 per annum for specially-abled students pursuing AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma programmes.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a specially-abled student with not less than 40% disability.
The applicant must be pursuing a technical degree or diploma course.
The family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 per annum.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Small savings account for a girl child carrying a high fixed rate of interest, with deposits qualifying for deduction under Section 80C and tax-free maturity proceeds.

clauses.text: The account may be opened by a guardian in the name of a girl child who has not attained the age of ten years.
A maximum of two accounts may be opened in a family, one for each of two girl children.
A minimum deposit of Rs. 250 and a maximum of Rs. 1,50,000 may be made in a financial year.

documents: Birth certificate of the girl child

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefits: Conditional maternity benefit of Rs. 5,000 for the first living child, and Rs. 6,000 for a second child if that child is a girl.

clauses.text: The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or lactating mother.
The beneficiary must have attained the age of 19 years or above on the date of the last menstrual period.
Women in regular employment with the Central or State Government or a public sector undertaking, who receive similar benefits, are excluded.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.benefits: A deposit-free LPG connection with the first refill and stove provided free of cost to the woman of an eligible household.

clauses.text: The applicant must be an adult woman belonging to a poor household.
The applicant must have attained 18 years of age.
No other LPG connection may exist in the applicant's household in the name of any family member.

The household must belong to one of the notified poor categories, including SC or ST households, beneficiaries under Antyodaya Anna Yojana and the poorest families identified through the fourteen-point declaration.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly and difficult areas for construction of a pucca house with a toilet and other basic amenities.

clauses.text: The beneficiary must be a rural household that is houseless or living in a kutcha or dilapidated house.
The household must be identified as deprived under the prescribed socio-economic criteria and verified by the Gram Sabha.
Households owning a pucca house, a motorised vehicle or a Kisan Credit Card with a limit above Rs. 50,000 are excluded.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans and assistance for construction or enhancement of a dwelling unit for eligible urban households.

clauses.text: The beneficiary family must reside in an urban area covered by the mission.
The annual household income must fall within the economically weaker section or low income group ceiling of Rs. 6,00,000.
The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in any part of India in the name of any family member.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.benefits: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals.

clauses.text: Families identified as deprived under the prescribed rural and urban occupational criteria of the socio-economic census are entitled to the cover.
There is no cap on family size, age or gender for members of an entitled family.
All pre-existing conditions are covered from the first day of entitlement.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Monthly old-age pension to elderly persons from below-poverty-line households, paid through the state government with an additional state top-up in most states.

clauses.text: The applicant must have attained the age of 60 years.
The applicant must belong to a household living below the poverty line as per the prescribed criteria.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension to widows from below-poverty-line households, disbursed by the state government along with any state top-up.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a widow.
The applicant must be between 40 and 79 years of age.
The applicant must belong to a household living below the poverty line.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension to persons with severe or multiple disabilities from below-poverty-line households.

clauses.text: The applicant must have a severe or multiple disability of 80% or more.
The applicant must be between 18 and 79 years of age.
The applicant must belong to a household living below the poverty line.

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: A legal guarantee of at least 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for such work.

clauses.text: The applicant must be an adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
The applicant must have completed 18 years of age.
The household must be registered with the Gram Panchayat and hold a job card.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at Rs. 10,000 with an interest subsidy of 7% and a cashback incentive on digital transactions.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a street vendor engaged in vending in urban areas.
The vendor must hold a certificate of vending or an identity card issued by the urban local body, or be identified in the vending survey.

documents: Certificate of vending or ULB identity card

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% of the project cost for setting up a new micro-enterprise in the manufacturing or service sector.

clauses.text: The applicant must have attained 18 years of age.
For projects costing above Rs. 10 lakh in manufacturing or Rs. 5 lakh in the service sector, the applicant must have passed at least Class 8.
Assistance is available only for new units; existing units and units already availing subsidy under another government scheme are not eligible.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch, for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

clauses.text: The borrower must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, or must be a woman entrepreneur.
The borrower must have attained 18 years of age.
The enterprise must be a greenfield project, being the borrower's first venture in manufacturing, services, trading or agriculture-allied activity.

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: One-time assistance of Rs. 20,000 to a below-poverty-line household on the death of its primary breadwinner.

clauses.text: The household must be living below the poverty line.
The deceased primary breadwinner must have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death.

schemes.name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.benefits: Investment support to farmer families in the state, paid in instalments and inclusive of the central PM-KISAN component.

clauses.text: The beneficiary must be a landholding farmer family resident in Andhra Pradesh.
The beneficiary must be engaged in cultivation.
Landless tenant farmers and cultivators belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Backward Class and Minority communities are also covered under the state component.

schemes.name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees for eligible students pursuing higher education courses in the state.

clauses.text: The student's family must be resident in Andhra Pradesh.
The student must be pursuing a recognised course after Class 12, including ITI, polytechnic, degree and postgraduate programmes.
The family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum and the family must not own more than 10 acres of wet land or 25 acres of dry land.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu - Agriculture Investment Support (Telangana)
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
schemes.benefits: Investment support per acre per season paid directly to landholding farmers for both the kharif and rabi seasons.

clauses.text: The beneficiary must be a landholding farmer with agricultural land recorded in Telangana.
The beneficiary must own cultivable land as per the state land records portal.
The beneficiary must be a farmer by occupation.

schemes.name: Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak (Telangana)
schemes.ministry: Department of Women Development and Child Welfare, Government of Telangana
schemes.benefits: One-time financial assistance towards the marriage expenses of an unmarried girl from an eligible family in the state.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a resident of Telangana.
The beneficiary must be an unmarried girl who has completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
The annual income of the family must not exceed Rs. 2,00,000.

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.benefits: Monthly assistance of Rs. 1,000 to girl students from government schools until they complete an undergraduate, diploma or ITI course.

clauses.text: The student must be a girl who studied Classes 6 to 12 in a government school in Tamil Nadu.
The student must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
The student must be pursuing higher education after Class 12.

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.ministry: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.benefits: Cashless health cover per family per year for listed surgeries and therapies at empanelled hospitals in the state.

clauses.text: The beneficiary family must be resident in Maharashtra.
The family must hold a yellow, orange, Antyodaya or Annapurna ration card, or belong to a notified distressed district.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
schemes.ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefits: Staged financial assistance to a girl child from birth through to graduation, released across six defined milestones.

clauses.text: The applicant family must be resident in Uttar Pradesh.
The benefit is payable in respect of a girl child in the family.
The annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000.
The benefit is limited to a maximum of two girl children in a family.

documents: Birth certificate of the girl child

schemes.name: Vidyasiri Food and Accommodation Scholarship (Karnataka)
schemes.ministry: Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Karnataka
schemes.benefits: Monthly food and accommodation assistance to students who could not secure a place in a government hostel.

clauses.text: The student must be a resident of Karnataka.
The student must be pursuing post-matriculation studies and must not be residing in a government hostel.
The annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Pre-matric scholarship for students of Other Backward Classes, Economically Backward Classes and Denotified Tribes studying in Classes 9 and 10.

clauses.text: The student must belong to an Other Backward Class, Economically Backward Class or Denotified Tribe.
The student must be studying in Class 9 or Class 10.
The annual income of the parents from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.

schemes.name: NSFDC Educational Loan for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Concessional educational loan for professional and technical courses in India and abroad, at a low rate of interest with a further concession for women.

clauses.text: The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste.
The annual family income must be within the double-the-poverty-line limit of Rs. 3,00,000.
The applicant must have secured admission to a recognised professional or technical course.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.ministry: Department of Fisheries
schemes.benefits: Subsidy support for fish production infrastructure, livelihood assistance during the fishing ban period and insurance cover for active fishers.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a fisher, fish farmer or fish worker.
Beneficiaries from Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and women categories receive an enhanced subsidy of 60% against the general rate of 40%.

schemes.name: Weavers' MUDRA Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Textiles
schemes.benefits: Margin money assistance and concessional working capital credit at 6% interest for handloom weavers and weaver entrepreneurs.

clauses.text: The applicant must be a handloom weaver or a weaver entrepreneur.
The applicant must hold a valid weaver identity card issued under the handloom census.

schemes.name: PM Internship Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
schemes.benefits: A twelve-month internship in a top company with a monthly stipend and a one-time grant, aimed at improving employability of young people.

clauses.text: The applicant must be between 21 and 24 years of age.
The applicant must not be employed full-time or enrolled in full-time education at the time of the internship.
The annual family income must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 and no family member may be in a permanent government job.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension between Rs. 1,000 and Rs. 5,000 from the age of 60, based on the contribution chosen at enrolment.

clauses.text: The subscriber must be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of joining.
The subscriber must hold a savings bank account and must not be an income-tax payer.
Contributions must be made until the subscriber attains 60 years of age.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh on death from any cause, for an annual premium of Rs. 436 auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account.

clauses.text: The subscriber must be between 18 and 50 years of age.
The subscriber must hold a savings bank account and give consent for auto-debit of the premium.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Accidental death and disability cover of Rs. 2 lakh for an annual premium of Rs. 20.

clauses.text: The subscriber must be between 18 and 70 years of age.
The subscriber must hold a savings bank account and give consent for auto-debit of the premium.
